title: Yummy Kenyan Tofu Stir-Fry
description: A quick, earthy and gooey plant-based stir-fry that blends Panang curry paste with fermented kimchi for a burst of umami flavor.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the tofu cubes and fry until golden on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the tofu from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, stir in the Panang curry paste until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the chopped kimchi, bell pepper, and carrot, and cook until the vegetables are slightly softened, about 4 minutes.
Return the tofu to the skillet and stir to coat with the curry mixture.
Pour in the soy sauce, maple syrup, and almond milk, stirring to combine.
Simmer the mixture for 3 minutes, letting the flavors meld together.
Sprinkle the toasted sesame seeds over the stir-fry and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the hot stir-fry over steamed rice or quinoa.
